title: A Sweet Welcome Home
segments: Linh was in her cozy home kitchen on a sunny Saturday afternoon. She was thinking about her older brother, Nam, who was coming home very soon. Linh wanted to make something special to welcome him. She loved art and being creative, so she decided to use her skills to make a unique gift just for him.

Because of this, Linh went to the fridge. She opened it and saw many colorful ingredients. She remembered Nam loved yogurt, so she decided to make a special yogurt dessert. Linh found some fresh berries, granola, and creamy plain yogurt. She carefully layered them into a tall, clear glass. It looked very beautiful and tasty already.

After that, Linh looked at her colorful yogurt dessert. It was so pretty, like a work of art! She thought, 'This would be perfect for Nam's welcome card!' But the plain kitchen counter was not a good background. She needed something more special for the photo. Linh wanted the card to be perfect.

Then, Linh looked around the kitchen for a good background. She spotted a bright red scarf. 'Perfect!' she thought. Linh carefully spread the soft scarf on the table. She gently placed her beautiful yogurt dessert on it. The red color made the dessert look even more amazing. Linh took many wonderful photos, creating a striking red background.

After that, Linh quickly printed the best photo for a beautiful card. She wrote a sweet message inside. Just then, she heard a key in the door! Nam was home. Linh quickly hid the dessert and card. When Nam walked in, Linh jumped out, shouting, 'Surprise!' Nam smiled widely, feeling very happy and loved by his thoughtful sister.

Because of this, Nam hugged Linh tightly. 'Thank you, little sister! This is the best welcome home ever,' he said, his eyes shining. He carefully took the beautiful card and looked at the photo of the colorful yogurt. Then, he happily ate the delicious dessert. Linh felt so warm and happy. Her creative gift made Nam feel truly loved.
endWrap: Linh smiled, knowing her artistic efforts brought joy. Nam felt deeply touched by her thoughtful, creative welcome. It was a perfect Saturday afternoon.
